anomalies.observed: On the schematic, the cathode side of D2 and the servo power rail feeding J3 pin 2, J8 pin 2, and C1-C4 are labeled +3V3. That +3V3 label is also used for the M5Stack bus 3.3 V supply and the MAX3485 supply/decoupling network (U1 pin 8, C5, R1, R8).
anomalies.expected: D2 should feed a dedicated servo power rail downstream of the +5V rail, not the +3V3 rail. The +3V3 rail is intended as the 3.3 V supply for the MAX3485 and M5Stack bus, with C5 as its decoupling capacitor.

D2 | PMEG3030EP Schottky, schematic note "3A 360mV" | Diode from `+5V` into the servo power rail (feeding J3/J8 pin 2 and the C1–C4 bank), selected for a low (≈360 mV @ 3A) forward drop.
C5 | 0.1 µF | Decoupling cap on `+3V3` (MAX3485 supply).

anomalies.impact: When +5V is present, D2 would diode-feed the +3V3 net, pulling it toward roughly 4.6 V and potentially damaging or mispowering 3.3 V devices and the M5Stack 3.3 V bus. The servo headers would also be powered from the wrong rail instead of the intended buffered servo supply.
